studies.origin: GG-authored reduction of .gg/motion-studies-bBxg5r/assets/studies.js signal branch, original 1.5–6.3 seconds
studies.behavior: Path progress, focal position and framing share one seekable state. The framing follows the moving signal, then reveals its complete route.
studies.useFor: Following a process, attention, flow or causal connection
studies.notMandatory: Camera following, palette, curves, circles, zoom or an abstract subject

studies.origin: Existing GG-owned library piece; also demonstrated by the local Type Becomes the World study
studies.behavior: A word changes from something to read into a spatial opening; incoming content inherits the outgoing focal position.
studies.useFor: A semantic transition with spatial continuity, not a generic cut between captions
studies.notMandatory: Huge type, a specific font, a portal, zooms in every shot or the local showreel's shot order
